description: This file contains implementation of certain AMP (Automatic Mixed Precision) operations optimized for Apple’s Metal Performance Shaders (MPS). It defines functions to check for non-finite values and unscale tensors, update scale factors, and manages Metal shader pipeline states, specific to MPS device context.

methods.name: _amp_non_finite_check_and_unscale_mps_single_impl
methods.description: Performs non-finite check and unscale operation on a single tensor on MPS.

methods.name: _amp_update_scale_mps_impl
methods.description: Updates the scaling factor for AMP on MPS device.

methods.name: getAmpCPLState
methods.description: Retrieves the Metal pipeline state for a given AMP function.

methods.name: _amp_foreach_non_finite_check_and_unscale_mps_
methods.description: Performs non-finite check and unscale on a list of tensors for AMP.

methods.name: _amp_update_scale_mps_
methods.description: Updates the scale factor for a list of tensors related to AMP.
